newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up on Pakistan and technical buy.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up on Pakistan and technical buy.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES -Talk that Pakistan may issue fresh tenders soon to buy December and first-half Jan palm oil, and technical buying helped prices to close higher. Activity picked up in the afternoon. Feb futures saw more support after breaking 1,220.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also moved in line with futures, and buyinginterest was also seen from refiners.
At the close, the contract closed 17 ringgit higher at 1,226 ringgit ($485.93) a tonne, also aided by technical buying.
Increased late buying saw turnover increase to 1,824 lots from 644 lots on Monday. Activity was confined to covering and switching from December to February and January to February.
News of India's import of U.S. sunflowerseed oil for Dec-Jan shipment had no impact on the market, traders said.

"India's news had no impact on the market," another trader said. "Fifty thousand tonnes of sunflowerseed oil is not a big ship for India. India does buy other vegetable oils but the buying is not on a regular basis," a trader said.

On Tuesday, India contracted to import about 50,000 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil from the United States for shipment in December and January, Navinbhai Shah, president of the Bombay Oilseeds and Oil Exchange Ltd said.
Among physical, Nov (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,230 ringgit with bids at 1,220 after trading at 1,215 and 1,220, and Nov (central) at 1,215 against 1,207.50.
Dec (south) saw offers at 1,240 ringgit and bids at 1,230 and earlier trades were 1,220 to 1,230 and Dec (central) was at 1,220 against 1,215.
Among refined products, Dec RBD palm oil was offered at $525 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Jan/Feb/March at $522.50. Jan/Feb/Mar was traded at $520.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $565 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $560. Dec was traded at $560 and Jan/Feb/Mar at $552.50.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $377.50 and Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-230-7510) ($1=2.5230 ringgit)
